name: AH 4010
title: Sexual and Reproductive Health
description: Sexual and reproductive health as a vital component of overall health and well-being across the lifespan. Topics include sexuality, sexually transmitted infections (STIs) and Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV), reproductive health, and inclusive care approaches. Tailored for future health professionals, the course highlights the role of trauma-informed, culturally competent, and equity-focused practices in clinical, public health, and health promotion settings.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
